niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces with strong, easy-to-scan hierarchy; clear sectioning and grouped content; concise text or icon-led summaries instead of large promotional imagery; visible, explicit actions; and polished, cohesive component systems. They often favor expressive, high-contrast, personality-rich screens when that improves clarity and actionability, but consistently reject fragmented structure, empty states, weak hierarchy, and visually noisy or incoherent layouts.

criteria.description: Strong top-down hierarchy with a prominent headline/title, clearly separated sections, and an obvious reading flow.
Content organized into coherent grouped sections or cards so benefits, settings, and actions feel distinctly packaged rather than fragmented.
Interfaces that make available actions and control states obvious through direct controls, visible options, and clear next steps.
Compact feature summaries, icon-led cards, and concise explanatory copy are preferred over large hero photos, carousels, or verbose text blocks.
Consistent rows, dividers, cards, spacing cadence, and repeated component patterns that create a steady, polished visual rhythm.
A composed, modern, product-like aesthetic with controlled decoration, cohesive icon treatment, and minimal clutter rather than mixed or noisy styling.
